title: Fixed-Width Records
subtitle: Parse, write, and inspect fixed-width, struct-template, and COBOL copybook records as typed columns.
provenance: Actual catalog tags from the released runtime used by the notebook

runtime_export.query: SELECT database_name, comment, map_extract_value(tags,'vgi.title') AS title, map_extract_value(tags,'vgi.subtitle') AS subtitle FROM duckdb_databases() WHERE map_extract_value(tags,'vgi.title') IS NOT NULL
rows: Fixed-width / Perl-unpack / Python-struct / COBOL-copybook record parsing and formatting for SQL.
